slot.brief: A loop/rail in a region where B varies with time (B = B0 + kt) or a rotating disc/rod: find induced emf via dΦ/dt with geometry, then current and power dissipated.

stem: A conducting bar slides along parallel rails separated by $0.50$ m, completing a circuit of resistance $0.50\ \Omega$. The loop is in a perpendicular field $B=(0.20+0.30t)$ T, and the bar position is $x=(0.40+0.20t)$ m ($t$ in seconds). What is the power dissipated at $t=1$ s?
solution:
The induced emf is $|\mathcal{E}|=\ell\,\frac{d(Bx)}{dt}=\ell(x\dot B+B\dot x)$. At $t=1\,\text{s}$, $B=0.50\,\text{T}$ and $x=0.60\,\text{m}$, so
$$|\mathcal{E}|=0.50[(0.60)(0.30)+(0.50)(0.20)]=0.14\,\text{V}.$$
Hence $P=\mathcal{E}^2/R=0.14^2/0.50=0.0392\,\text{W}$.
